title: parseTrackerModelSpec
responsibility: Resolve Tracker model pins and preserve the installed catalog, effort defaults, and project allowlist.

inputs.name: ladderFrom.config
inputs.description: Optional configuration overriding matching default ladder entries.

inputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec.spec
inputs.description: Model name or alias with an optional reasoning effort suffix.

inputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec.ladder
inputs.description: Current ladder entries and their model and effort defaults.

inputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec.project
inputs.description: Project name used for model allowlists, or null.

inputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec.config
inputs.description: Optional Tracker configuration with project allowlists.

outputs.name: solEfforts
outputs.description: Supported Sol reasoning efforts in increasing order.

outputs.name: ladderFrom
outputs.description: Default ladder with configured matching overrides and unchanged CLI selections.

outputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec
outputs.description: Validated pinned model and effort selected for this project.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: The model syntax, model version, named effort, or project is invalid for the requested pin.
